scope: Final bounded candidate: attempt-fenced Heijunka leases, capacity-accounted deferred reclaim, and in-memory transfer/recipient receipts with composite plan/task identity. No integration, completion, deployment, or admission authority.

snapshot.reference: Isolated JJ parent 337f99137673d7866b958a38bd490fb876b2880f; scoped final candidate bytes observed directly.

criticality.rationale: Unbounded retained work, non-fenced completion, or response replay can corrupt scheduling control.

stpa.rationale: Unsafe work actions include replay, wrong recipient, another worker lease release, and over-capacity intake.

fmea.rationale: FM-SCHEDULER-FENCING S5 O2 Det3 RPN30; severity floor F5.

impact.rationale: Protects bounded in-model scheduling and work identity.

fmea_modes.cause: Leases lacked attempts, reclaimed work could overflow, and transfers lacked receipt/recipient fences.
fmea_modes.effect: Incorrectly released, replayed, or unbounded work.
fmea_modes.controls: Typed tests and bounded state; all new paths are compiled and executed locally.

stpa_analysis.control_action: Admit, pull, complete, reclaim, and adopt work

ucas.context: Replay receipt is absent after accepted work leaves queue.
ucas.constraint: Accepted transfer receipts persist for the model lifetime.

ucas.context: Completion removes peer lease or intake grows retained queue.
ucas.constraint: Completion includes worker and attempt; admission counts deferred tasks.

ucas.context: Response is applied to another recipient or replayed after consumption.
ucas.constraint: Receipt binds donor, recipient, explicit transfer ID.

ucas.context: Expired work is deferred without backpressure.
ucas.constraint: Deferred work is capacity-accounted and drained by pulls.

decision.summary: Test-first local candidate repair for all reviewed scheduler negative paths.
alternatives: Repair typed model and direct tests
assumptions: No direct callers beyond searched direct tests at this base.
Model receipt lifetime is not disk durability.
counterevidence: No live multi-node transport or restart persistence is demonstrated.
decision.forecast: Red tests fail before this state change and pass with it.
decision.falsifier: Any mismatch owner/attempt release, overfull visible queue, unbounded intake, wrong recipient, or replay changes work incorrectly.
decision.rollback: Preserve candidate and receipts; no integration/deploy/complete/admit.
decision.budget: Realized Gleam/OTP inputs only; +S 2:2; no downloads.
decision.reviewer: Parent EV admission coordinator and independent reviewer.
residuals: In-memory transfer receipts are not network or disk fences.
